title: Disable NVIDIA GSP firmware to fix crashes
summary: The GSP firmware enabled by default in newer NVIDIA drivers can cause crashes and Vulkan failures. Disable it via a kernel module parameter.
prerequisites: You are using the proprietary NVIDIA driver (version 555+).

steps.explain: Create or edit a modprobe configuration file to disable GSP.
Add the line 'options nvidia NVreg_EnableGpuFirmware=0' to /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia.conf.
Regenerate the initramfs if the nvidia module is included there.

rollback.explain: Remove the line from /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia.conf and regenerate initramfs.

warnings: This only works with the proprietary driver, not the open-source nvidia-open.
